rules.sentence: Local eradication with cryotherapy (superficial freezing) or topical agents is effective and safe.
Squamous cell carcinoma is a common tumor that typically arises on sun-exposed sites in older adults.
Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma is mainly caused by UV light exposure, which leads to widespread DNA damage and extremely high mutational loads (Chapter 6).
As one might imagine, patients with the rare disorder xeroderma pigmentosum, which disrupts repair of UV-induced DNA damage, are at an exceptionally high risk.
